title: Incorrect discount calculation
description: Discount is divided by 10 instead of 100.
expected_behavior: A 10 percent discount on 1000 should return 100.

title: Double tax calculation
description: Tax is multiplied by 2, causing double the intended tax.

title: Double inventory deduction
description: The checkout function deducts the purchased quantity from inventory twice.
expected_behavior: Purchasing 2 laptops should reduce stock from 10 to 8.
actual_behavior: Purchasing 2 laptops reduces stock from 10 to 6.

verification.note: BUG-003 was verified independently before BUG-004 was introduced. In the combined test run, BUG-004 prevents checkout from reaching the duplicate stock deduction.

title: Incorrect insufficient-stock validation
description: The stock validation condition is reversed, allowing checkout to proceed when stock is insufficient.
expected_behavior: Checkout should raise ValueError when the requested quantity exceeds available stock.
actual_behavior: Checkout continues when check_stock returns False.

title: Discount ignored in final billing
description: The final billing calculation uses the original subtotal instead of subtracting the discount before calculating tax.
expected_behavior: A subtotal of 1000 with a discount of 100 should produce a total of 1062 at an 18 percent tax rate.
actual_behavior: The discount is ignored. The current result is 1360 because the existing double-tax defect also affects the calculation.

title: Unknown products are incorrectly accepted
description: The check_stock method returns True for products that do not exist in inventory.
expected_behavior: Return False when the requested product is not present in inventory.
actual_behavior: Returns True for an unknown product instead of False.
